name: Raspberry Pi Web Kiosk
description: Raspberry Pi OS web kiosk with boot-partition URL configuration

features: Automatic login to an unprivileged Chromium kiosk session
Website configured in kiosk-url.txt on the Windows/macOS-readable boot partition
Guided on-screen Wi-Fi setup at first boot (network list, password or username + password); saved permanently
Optional automatic sign-in to a network login page using the saved Wi-Fi credentials (kiosk-portal.txt)
Personal and enterprise Wi-Fi (PEAP, TTLS, TLS, PWD, FAST, LEAP) configured in kiosk-wifi.txt
Preset for Sydney: Australia/Sydney timezone, en_AU locale, AU Wi-Fi country, Google time servers
No first-boot account setup; the administrator account is locked
Daily updates from the official stable OS and security repositories
compatibility: HDMI display, 16 GB or larger boot media; 2 GB RAM or more recommended (the Pi 3B+ has 1 GB)
known_issues: Wi-Fi settings and certificates are applied on boot but deleted files may be recoverable from the card
The administrator account is locked, so there is no console login; reflash to maintain
Reboot during maintenance to apply kernel updates and restart the updated browser

build.base_os: Raspberry Pi OS Lite (64-bit), Debian Trixie
